descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We are a Mainframe Application Support team working with business-critical enterprise systems and international customers. Our focus is on reliable operations, effective incident resolution and continuous improvement.
We are looking for a Mainframe Support Consultant with foundational mainframe knowledge who wants to further develop their expertise in enterprise mainframe operations and technologies such as IBM z/OS, GDPS and System Automation. You will work alongside experienced colleagues and customer teams, building deeper technical expertise through Knowledge Transfer and hands-on experience. Fluent German is essential, as customer communication and technical and operational discussions will primarily take place in German.
 What You'll Be Doing
Provide operational support for IBM mainframe environments based on documented procedures and runbooks.
Monitor systems, identify alerts and incidents, and perform initial analysis and troubleshooting.
Handle and document incidents, service requests and operational activities.
Execute standard operational procedures and predefined recovery actions.
Escalate complex incidents to senior or third-level support teams when required.
Support mainframe technologies and environments involving IBM GDPS, System Automation, SAN and storage infrastructure.
Participate in Knowledge Transfer, shadowing and reverse-shadowing sessions to build project-specific technical knowledge.
Maintain and improve operational documentation and runbooks.
Communicate with customer representatives and internal technical teams in German and English.
Participate in a shift-based support model, including early, late and/or night shifts, with on-call activities after completing the required training and onboarding.
 What You'll Bring Along
Fluent German skills, both spoken and written.
Good English communication skills.
Foundational knowledge of IBM mainframe environments, ideally z/OS, or initial hands-on experience in mainframe operations/support.
Good understanding of IT infrastructure, IT operations or enterprise systems.
Basic understanding of incident management and troubleshooting principles.
Ability to follow technical procedures and work with structured documentation.
Strong interest in developing expertise in specialized mainframe technologies such as GDPS, System Automation and enterprise storage.
Willingness to work in shifts and participate in on-call activities after the onboarding period.
Structured, reliable and service-oriented way of working, with good communication and teamwork skills.
